tools.description: Get metadata (CDN URL, size, MIME type, dimensions) for one PixelVault image by id. Maps to GET /v1/images/:id. tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show your plan, this month's usage (storage, uploads) and what is left of the quota, so you can check before a bulk upload. Maps to GET /v1/usage. Read-only. Requires a PixelVault API key sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

tools.name: delete_image
tools.description: Permanently delete one PixelVault image by id. Maps to DELETE /v1/images/:id. Requires a PixelVault API key sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_image, list_images, upload_image, upload_batch, get_collection, close_collection, rescue_imgur, upgrade_plan, manage_billing · Private data: get_image, list_images, get_usage, delete_image, create_upload_url, upload_image, upload_batch, list_collections, get_collection, close_collection, sign_url, transform_image, rescue_imgur, upgrade_plan, manage_billing · Public sink: get_usage, create_upload_url, upload_image, upload_batch, close_collection, sign_url, rescue_imgur, upgrade_plan, manage_billing · Destructive: get_image, list_images, delete_image, upload_image, upload_batch, list_collections, transform_image, rescue_imgur.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_image, list_images, upload_image, upload_batch, get_collection, close_collection, rescue_imgur, upgrade_plan, manage_billing · Private data: get_image, list_images, get_usage, delete_image, create_upload_url, upload_image, upload_batch, list_collections, get_collection, close_collection, sign_url, transform_image, rescue_imgur, upgrade_plan, manage_billing · Public sink: get_usage, create_upload_url, upload_image, upload_batch, close_collection, sign_url, rescue_imgur, upgrade_plan, manage_billing · Destructive: get_image, list_images, delete_image, upload_image, upload_batch, list_collections, transform_image, rescue_imgur

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "upload_image" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Prefer file for attachments; optional `folder`, `filename`"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
